QuestInfo.name: Special Training Emergency Roundup
QuestInfo.0: After you reach Level 100, the headmaster strikes up a conversation with you.
QuestInfo.1: The Headmaster tells you to go quickly to the #bSchool#k and meet your teacher, because there is a #bSpecial Training Emergency Roundup#k. You heard that a different teacher will be in charge this time...you wonder what is going on with the Resistance. Go quickly to the #bUnderground Base#k.
QuestInfo.2: The Job Instructor is not at the Underground Base... #p2151003# meets you instead. Her expression confirms your suspicion...something must be wrong.

0.0: #h0#! Are you busy? We're doing an emergency drill to round up all student participating in the Special Training program.\r\n#L0##bAn emergency call? For what? Did something happen?#l\n#k
0.1: Oh, no, it's just a drill. Don't worry. But do head over the your classroom as soon as humanly possible. Go right NOW, if you can. Now, #h0#. \r\n#L0##b(The Headmaster looks frantic! Did the Black Wings find out about the Resistance?!)#l\n#k
0.2: Yes, head over the classroom. The sooner the better. Snip snap, get a move on, GO.

yes.0: Your homeroom teacher won't be there. Instead, meet a, uh, substitute teacher in charge of emergency drills. Now head to the #bSchool#k and talk to the teacher. Hurry!

no.0: I know students occasionally lack motivation, but sometimes some things are simply TOO important. Now, talk to me again.

1.0: #h0#! I've been waiting for you! I'm sure you've realized by now that your job instructor isn't here. He was sent on a mission and we've lost all contact with him...

yes.0: Please, calm down. I understand that you're shocked, but you need to pull yourself together! Talk to me again after you take a deep breath.

npc.0: This is an emergency drill. Look alive! Rush to the #bSchool#k and find your classroom. The teacher in charge of the emergency drills awaits!
npc.1: #b(Did something happen to the Resistance? He's never looked so anxious before! Hurry to the School!)#k
